Study with usInternational students
A warm welcome awaits
The University of Strathclyde is a leading international technological university.
We're located in the heart of Glasgow - one of the UK’s largest cities. We have a vibrant, international community with almost 30,000 students from over 140 countries.
For over 200 years Strathclyde has been delivering academic excellence. Studying with us, you'll enjoy world-class research and teaching in preparation for your chosen career path.
There are international application deadlines in place for postgraduate taught courses beginning in September 2026

Entry requirements
Find the entry requirements for your country.
Entry requirements
Truly global
Only a one-hour flight from London, Glasgow also has great transport links from the rest of the UK, Europe and the world.
You can fly to some of Europe's top destinations directly from Glasgow including Paris, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Berlin and Dubrovnik. Direct flights are also available to/from Dubai with flight times of around 7h 30.
What you need to know
Before you arrive
What do you need to know before you leave home? Don’t worry, we’ve got the answers for you! Take a look at our helpful hints and tips before you arrive so you can make the most of your time when you get here.
Visas & immigration
Non-UK students who wish to pursue studies at the University of Strathclyde typically require a visa. Discover the options available to you.
While you're here
We’ll be here to help you right from the start! Find out more about visa extensions, working during studies, the cost of living in Glasgow and much more in our ‘while you’re here’ section.
Scholarships
We've lots of scholarships and funding opportunities to support you in your studies. Take a look at our scholarships search to find out how we can support you.
Scholarships search
English language requirements
What level of English will you need for your course? Find out about the English language requirements and courses we offer to improve your English.
English Language Teaching
Is English not your first language? Do you need to improve to meet language conditions of your degree offer? Are you simply looking to practice your English skills? We're here to help.
University preparation programmes
The University of Strathclyde International Study Centre offers international students who don't meet direct academic entry requirements the option to complete a pathway programme. Upon successful completion, you can progress to your chosen degree at the University.
Approved educational advisors & agents
We work with a network of high-quality recruitment partners from across the world, to help you with your application process. Find an approved educational advisor or agent in your country.
Explore Scotland
Home to some of the most magnificent landscapes in the UK, and with Glasgow as a base, you're only a short journey from exploring everything Scotland has to offer.
You can enjoy activities ranging from hill walking, snow sports, world-class mountain bike trails and water sports to climbing. Or for those who want to discover Scotland’s past, you can visit the country’s many historic castles and monuments and explore the thriving arts and culture scene of the surrounding towns and cities.
